cpu-validation.json records successful --validate-only for all seven groups (return code 0, no model loaded, no network access). The validation record is consistent with the manifests and commands; it is syntax/fixture validation only, not model execution.

Recomputed the seven group ranges from the stated per-case envelopes plus one 180-second process margin: total point 10141.0994 s (169.0183 min), total range 8460–23660 s (141.0–394.3333 min), and 1260 s total reload margin. Every group upper sensitivity value is below its timeout (2048 groups 3380<3600 s; 4096 groups 4980<7200 s). Historical 512-prefix median inputs are separately pinned in cost-basis.json. The 1024/2048/4096-prefix cases have no matched HF timing; point values for 2048/4096 are placeholders and their broad ranges are sensitivity assumptions, not measured bounds. The report states this explicitly.
